title: Assembler::add_part() in yencoding-multi: overlapping ranges return Err but gap behavior undocumented
description: yencoding-multi::Assembler::add_part() returns AssemblyError::OverlappingPart when two parts cover the same byte range. The error includes existing and new Range<u64>. However, the behavior for gaps is not documented: if parts 1 and 3 are added but part 2 is missing, what does finish() return? Does it return Err, return Ok with zeroed bytes in the gap, or panic? What goes wrong: a caller collecting multipart yEnc posts that receives 2 of 3 parts and calls finish() (perhaps after a timeout) will get an undocumented result. The contract must specify: either finish() errors if any byte range is unwritten, or it specifies what fill value is used, or it panics (which then needs to become an Err per the no-panic rule). File: yencoding-multi/src/assembler.rs.
